key_issues_to_review.issue_content: The generated brief text for a chain-break packet hardcodes the name `Ethan` ("the last packet Ethan acted on") instead of referencing the actual reviewer/actor for the ticket. If this text is surfaced to or about other reviewers, it will be factually wrong and confusing for anyone other than that specific person. If `Ethan` is a deliberate persona convention elsewhere in this codebase, this can be disregarded, but it reads like leftover test/placeholder content.
